name: OpenSparrow Self-Hosted App Builder
free_limit: LGPL-3.0-licensed self-hosted PHP platform for schema-driven CRUD apps, forms, dashboards and calendars on PostgreSQL; no vendor software usage quota or expiry documented.
watch_out: Requires PHP 8.4+, PostgreSQL 14+ and your own hosting/storage; Render/Railway deployment may incur provider charges. Optional RAG uses local Ollama or separately billed AI APIs. LGPL-3.0 obligations apply when distributing modified code; review security before production.
